# eBay
> Global online marketplace for buying and selling electronics, vehicles, fashion, collectibles, parts, and everyday goods.

eBay combines consumer shopping, auctions, fixed-price listings, seller tools, buyer account management, and support resources. Key areas include marketplace browsing, deals, vehicle parts and motors, selling workflows, My eBay account features, payments, and help documentation.

## Marketplace
- [eBay Home](https://www.ebay.com): Main marketplace homepage for browsing products across electronics, fashion, collectibles, motors, and more.
- [Deals](https://www.ebay.com/deals): Curated daily deals, discounts, and limited-time offers across major shopping categories.
- [Brand Outlet](https://www.ebay.com/b/Brand-Outlet/bn_7115532402): Brand storefront hub featuring outlet pricing from participating brands and retailers.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.ebay.com/giftcards): Buy, redeem, and learn about eBay gift cards and supported use cases.

## Buying & My eBay
- [My eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mys/home?source=GBH): Central account area for tracking buying, selling, and saved activity.
- [Summary](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/summary): Overview of recent account activity, orders, alerts, and recommendations.
- [Watchlist](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/watchlist): Saved items list for monitoring listings, prices, and auction activity.
- [Recently Viewed](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/rvi): History of recently viewed items for quick return browsing.
- [Bids/Offers](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): Track auction bids, Best Offers, and offer-related activity.
- [Purchase History](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/purchase): View completed orders, order details, and post-purchase actions.
- [Buy Again](https://www.ebay.com/mye/buyagain): Reorder previously purchased items and discover replenishment suggestions.

## Saved Preferences
- [Saved Feed](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/saved): Personalized feed of saved items, searches, and shopping interests.
- [Saved Searches](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/savedsearches): Manage saved search queries and alerts for matching listings.
- [Saved Sellers](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/savedsellers): Follow favorite sellers and manage seller subscriptions.

## Selling
- [Sell on eBay](https://www.ebay.com/sl/sell): Entry point for creating listings and starting to sell on eBay.
- [Selling Overview](https://www.ebay.com/mys/home?CurrentPage=MyeBayAllSelling&ssPageName=STRK:ME:LNLK:MESX&source=GBH): Seller dashboard for active, unsold, sold, and draft listings.
- [Seller Center](https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter): Seller education hub with tools, policies, and business guidance.
- [Seller Hub](https://www.ebay.com/sh/ovw): Unified workspace for listings, orders, performance, and marketing tools.
- [Selling Fees](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4364): Help page explaining listing fees, final value fees, and charges.
- [Start Getting Paid](https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter/payments-and-fees/payments-and-fees): Overview of seller payments, payouts, and fee management.

## Motors & Vehicles
- [eBay Motors](https://www.ebay.com/b/Auto-Parts-and-Vehicles/6000/bn_1865334): Marketplace for vehicles, parts, accessories, and automotive tools.
- [My Garage](https://www.ebay.com/g/mygarage): Save vehicles to find compatible parts and accessories more easily.
- [Motors Seller Center](https://pages.ebay.com/motors/sellercenter/): Resources for listing and selling vehicles, parts, and accessories.
- [Vehicle Purchase Protection](https://pages.ebay.com/motors/buy/purchase-protection/): Information about protections available for eligible vehicle purchases.
- [Tires](https://www.ebay.com/b/Tires/179680/bn_1851346): Browse tire listings by size, brand, and vehicle compatibility.
- [Car & Truck Parts](https://www.ebay.com/b/Car-Truck-Parts-Accessories/6030/bn_569479): Major category for replacement parts, accessories, and maintenance products.

## Help & Support
- [Help & Contact](https://www.ebay.com/help/home): Main support portal for buying, selling, account, and policy questions.
- [Buying Help](https://www.ebay.com/help/buying?id=4000): Support articles for orders, returns, bidding, offers, and payments.
- [Selling Help](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling?id=4100): Support articles for listings, shipping, fees, and seller performance.
- [Account Help](https://www.ebay.com/help/account?id=4200): Guidance for account settings, security, registration, and sign-in issues.
- [Shipping & Tracking Help](https://www.ebay.com/help/shipping?id=4079): Help with shipping options, delivery, tracking, and international orders.
- [Returns & Refunds Help](https://www.ebay.com/help/returns-refunds?id=4041): Policies and workflows for returns, refunds, and item-not-received issues.

## Payments & Billing
- [Payments](https://ppcapp.ebay.com/myppc/wallet/list): Wallet and payments area for managing stored payment methods and transactions.
- [Paying for Items](https://www.ebay.com/help/buying/paying-items?id=4033): Buyer help for checkout, payment methods, and payment issues.
- [Seller Payments Help](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/getting-paid?id=4814): Help documentation for payouts, holds, and managed payments topics.
- [Fees, Credits and Invoices](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices?id=4122): Seller billing reference for charges, credits, and invoice management.

## Account Access
- [Sign in](https://signin.ebay.com/ws/eBayISAPI.dll?SignIn&sgfl=gh): Secure sign-in page for accessing eBay accounts and personalized features.
- [Register](https://signup.ebay.com/pa/crte): Account creation page for new personal or business users.
- [Account Settings](https://accountsettings.ebay.com/uas): Manage personal information, addresses, communications, and account preferences.
- [Personal Information](https://accountsettings.ebay.com/uas/pi): Update name, contact details, and core account profile information.
- [Addresses](https://accountsettings.ebay.com/uas/addresses): Manage shipping and billing addresses associated with the account.
- [Communication Preferences](https://accountsettings.ebay.com/uas/notification-preferences): Control email, alerts, and notification settings.

## Policies & Trust
- [eBay Money Back Guarantee](https://pages.ebay.com/ebay-money-back-guarantee/): Buyer protection policy for eligible items not received or not as described.
- [Verified Rights Owner Program](https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter/ebay-for-business/verified-rights-owner-program): Intellectual property reporting program for rights owners and brands.
- [Abusive Buyer Policy](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/rules-policies-buyers/abusive-buyer-policy?id=4374): Policy describing prohibited buyer behavior and enforcement.
- [Seller Performance Standards](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/selling/seller-levels-performance-standards?id=4347): Standards and metrics used to evaluate seller performance.
- [Prohibited and Restricted Items](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/prohibited-restricted-items/prohibited-restricted-items?id=4207): Rules governing items that cannot be listed or have listing restrictions.
- [User Agreement](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/member-behaviour-policies/user-agreement?id=4259): Core legal terms governing use of the eBay marketplace.
